name: Calculate Booking Incentive
script:
if doc.agency_contract and doc.from_date and doc.to_date:
    
    contract = frappe.get_doc("Agency Contract", doc.agency_contract)
    
    doc.agency_name = contract.agency_name
    doc.account_manager = contract.account_manager
    
    segments = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT 
            SUM(todd_air + sabre_air + midt_air) as total_air,
            SUM(todd_ndc + sabre_ndc + midt_ndc) as total_ndc,
            SUM(todd_sc + sabre_sc + midt_sc) as total_sc
        FROM `tabSegment Report`
        WHERE agency = %(agency)s
    """, {"agency": doc.agency_contract}, as_dict=True)
    
    if segments and segments[0].total_air:
        doc.total_air = segments[0].total_air or 0
        doc.total_ndc = segments[0].total_ndc or 0
        doc.total_sc = segments[0].total_sc or 0
        doc.total_segments = doc.total_air + doc.total_ndc + doc.total_sc
    
    rate = 0
    for tier in contract.tiers:
        if tier.tier_type == "AIR":
            if doc.total_air >= tier.from_val and doc.total_air <= tier.to:
                rate = tier.rate
                break
    
    doc.based_incentives = (doc.total_segments or 0) * rate
    doc.total = (
        (doc.based_incentives or 0) +
        (doc.upfront or 0) -
        (doc.shortfall or 0) +
        (doc.ek_a_option or 0) -
        (doc.paid or 0)
    )
